name: wows-omp-plugin-judge-dispatch
description: Route OMP subagent types and pick their models with native judge-role judgments

routeAgent.description: Let the judge replace the agent type a task call requests

selectModel.description: Pick each task spawn's model from its agent's flattened model pool (selectors plus every role's fallback chain)

modelBudget.description: Which pool models selectModel may use, relative to the agent's primary model: max never goes below it, minimum allows any

modelPick.description: best: the judge's best-fitting eligible model; weighted: sample by fit, provider weight, and cheapness

providerWeights.description: Provider preference multipliers as provider=weight pairs separated by commas, e.g. openai=2,anthropic=1 (unlisted providers weigh 1)

judgeEffort.description: Also let the judge set each task call's thinking effort (lo/med/hi), replacing the requested one

minimumConfidence.description: Minimum native judgment confidence required to change an agent type, effort, or best-picked model

includeSharedContext.description: Include the task call's shared context in the routing judgment

indicator.description: Show a working message while judging and a status line for every routed task call (never sent to the model)
